frontmatter.sidebar_description: Credit one or more store credit accounts.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `creditAccountsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow credits one or more store credit accounts with transactions.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows,
allowing you to wrap custom logic around crediting store credit accounts.

steps.name: creditAccountStep
steps.description:
This step credits one or more store credit accounts with transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.
